mods.name: JumpReset
mods.description: PvP jump reset timing trainer with configurable HUD. Press K to open settings.

releases.notes:
A polish release: every UI surface reviewed, several long-standing HUD/config bugs fixed, and the visual layer refreshed. Detection pipeline unchanged — config files are fully compatible.

## Bug Fixes
- Main HUD and history strip now respect **F1 / hide-HUD** (previously only the crosshair triangle did)
- Disabling the mod fully hides the HUD (debug overlay and history strip kept rendering)
- `ModConfig.save()` sanitizes before writing — sliders can no longer persist out-of-order timing thresholds
- HUD preview **drag hit-box** now matches the active style (Bar / Minimal were using the Detailed panel's box)
- Config screen title reads the version from mod metadata (was hardcoded "v2.0")
- MISSED results show `-- ms` instead of a bogus `9999 ms`
- Config loading falls back to defaults on any runtime parse error

## Visual Improvements
- **Style-aware config preview**: renders the real Minimal pill / Detailed panel / Timing Bar (zones + marker)
- Drop shadows on all HUD panels and the crosshair triangle
- History strip highlights the newest entry and anchors correctly under all three styles
- Active config tab gets a green accent underline

## Installation
Drop `jumpreset-v3.0.0.jar` into `.minecraft/mods` (requires Fabric Loader ≥ 0.18.0, Fabric API, Minecraft 1.21.11, Java 21). Client-side only.

Full changelog: see [README](https://github.com/sombreror/JumpReset-mod#changelog)

releases.notes:
What's New in v2.5.0

- Timing sliders now control the rating — Perfect ≤ / Good ≤ / Late ≤ (and the on-screen bar zones) now actually decide whether a hit is rated PERFECT / GOOD / LATE, so tuning them finally changes your feedback.
- "Show Missed" indicator — optionally display a MISSED readout when the timing window closes without a jump. Purely visual: it never counts toward your session stats or streaks. (Off by default.)

▎ Your existing jumpreset.json config carries over unchanged.
